objective: Prioritize observed net annual >500%, not scan counts or infrastructure completion. A result for one bull year is not repeated annual500% or a future guarantee.
scope_change: NEW diversified crypto spot rotation, not BTC-only and not original BTC Pressure. BTC-only and cash controls mandatory. Fully funded, no leverage, shorting, borrowing or exchange orders.
universe_limit: Predetermined named cohort, not historical complete market or survivor-bias-free universe. All were named before current results, but asset selection may benefit from hindsight. No claim about assets outside this cohort.

data.source: Official monthly ZIPs and published CHECKSUM. Missing monthly404 may use ALL daily ZIPs of that same month; no date omissions, no futures substitutions. No purchases or access-control bypass.

signal: Rank positive trailing21/63/126-day close momentum, either raw or divided by trailing60-day daily-return volatility. Eligible only with close>SMA100, complete101-day close support and preceding30-day mean quote volume>=5mUSDT. Select top1/3/5; each selected asset gets1/K of the allocation budget; unfilled slots stay cash. Quantities remain fixed between scheduled1/7-day rebalances.
time: At day D open use the frame formed at day D-2 close (a full24h delay after completed daily information). Rebalance anchored to actual calendar days, not an optimized starting weekday. Prior holdings receive the open gap before rebalance. No intraday stop fills inferred from OHLC.
selection: 2021-2023 only: among configs with positive net CAGR, close-DD<=50%,>=12 rebalance events and complete accounting, select highest CAGR/max(10%,abs(DD)); ties config ID. Freeze before2024 validation and2025-Aug2026 evaluation. No later winner replaces primary or selection. Retain all36 results, including failed/no-trade controls.
history: Market history was inspected repeatedly in earlier program; this is exploratory reused-history research, not pristine OOS. Full-diagnostic winners or500% years must be explicitly ex-post diagnostics.

execution.method: One shared cash-and-coin ledger; sells first then cash-limited buys, costed each side. No sums of independent leveraged strategy curves. Actual historical instrument filters/impact unverified.

gaps: Retain a validity mask. No price forward-fill for fills. Gaps while exposed invalidate validated-return fields; diagnostic accounting may resume with explicit gap flag. Reset lookback support after gaps. No deletion of losing assets or periods after results.
risk: Full spot allocation may have large drawdowns; no assertion of the old10% DD or0.25% per-trade risk. Report close-DD and conservative simultaneous-daily-low stress separately. Quarter-allocation is a comparator, not a guarantee.
primary_and_selected_stresses: exclude each of the nine cohort assets in turn; same ranking rules and cash slots; all exclusions reported
statistics: Count actual costed order fills/rebalances separately from condition hours and round trips. Report annual calendar returns, multiyear CAGR, worst rolling365d, profitable months, turnover, fees. Block-bootstrap interval is exploratory, not a multiple-testing correction.
incumbent: Independently rerun existing V517/V524 code on its hash-pinned V75 input when present; retain its account-level/non-pristine boundary. V75 annual returns shown alongside new models where periods match, never silently inherit50.55% by the new strategy.
testing: same source hashes for local and CI reproduction
delivery: Isolated research in fin with readable results and full ledgers via PR. No changes to blocked controller.py, production scheduler, real order permissions or user capital.
